nbaInjuries.name: Anthony Edwards
nbaInjuries.note: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

nbaInjuries.name: Jayson Tatum
nbaInjuries.note: Tatum will be rested Wednesday against the Bucks, Jack Simone of BostonSportsJournal.com reports.

nbaInjuries.note: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

nbaInjuries.note: Haliburton (hamstring) will miss at least the next two weeks of action, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

nbaInjuries.name: Brandon Ingram
nbaInjuries.note: The Clippers recalled Ingram (Achilles) from the G League's San Diego Clippers on Sunday.
